name: @rayspec/fixture-pack
description: The in-tree extension pack that exercises the pack seams end to end. It claims ONE top-level section (`auditing`) and ships the validator for it, and it OWNS one platform table through a migration chain of its own (`migrations/`, prefix `fixture_pack_`); the deployment documents beside it are loaded through the REAL loader from THIS directory, with a REAL exact version pin. Unlike the @spike/* example packs it is a normal @rayspec/* workspace member, so the CI filters build and typecheck it: a fixture excluded from CI proves nothing. It builds to dist/ because the deploy runtime loads compiled JavaScript only, and a deployment document points at that directory.

scripts.//build: The pack's manifest declares its migration chain as a directory INSIDE the pack root, and a deployment's `module` points at the BUILT pack (`./dist`) because the loader imports compiled JavaScript only. So the committed chain — the same bytes `gate:pack-migrations` scans at `migrations/` — is emitted beside the compiled entry, exactly as a pack published from its own repository would ship it inside its package. `tsc` copies no `.sql`, hence the explicit copy.
